name: Behavior Callout
definition: Points out a user’s behavior that is highlighted by the label, either in text and/or in a screenshot. References the labels to say something about a user.

name: Label Interpretation
definition: A personal understanding or interpretation of the label’s meaning.

name: Recommendation
definition: Recommends the labeler to others; could also include a link.

name: Self-Use Experience
definition: A description of someone’s experience with the labeler or how someone uses the label; could also include a link.

name: User Behavior Change
definition: Describes avoiding or changing interaction with a labeled account.

name: Creator Behavior Change
definition: Self-monitoring or self-regulation due to being labeled or trying to avoid being labeled.

name: Reaction to Being Labeled — Self-Directed Humor
definition: Self-disclosure of being labeled and a humorous reaction to that.

name: Reaction to Being Labeled — Angry/Complaint
definition: Self-disclosure of being labeled and a complaint about it or about its reliability.

name: Reaction to Being Labeled — Other
definition: Self-disclosure of being labeled and a reaction to that.

name: Mentioned as Part of a Conversation
definition: When the labeler or a label is casually mentioned as part of a discussion and is not directly the focus of the post.

name: Technical Issue Report
definition: A user mentions that the labeler is down, not working, etc.

name: User Label Clarification
definition: When an unsubscribed user sees the labels in another user’s post, usually as a screenshot, and asks about them.

name: Feature/Label Suggestion
definition: New label suggestions, label edits, or reactions to new/changed labels, etc.
